# PM010: cycle-over-capacity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | PM |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | advisory |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

An open or planned cycle commits more points than its capacity.

Advisory only. Capacity is the cycle's own `capacity_points`, else
`rolling_mean - k * stddev` once `[pm] min_history` cycles have closed;
before that nothing is enforced and the rule is silent.

## Remedy

Move tickets out with `frob cycle unassign TICKET`, raise the cycle's
capacity, or accept the over-commit (`frob cycle assign --over-commit
--reason TEXT` records why).

## Examples

### PM010 cycle over capacity / A cycle committing more than its capacity fires #1 (line 11) (fire)

```text
task a points=5
task b points=5
cycle c start=-1 end=5 capacity=8 members=a,b
```

### PM010 cycle over capacity / A cycle at its capacity is clean #2 (line 19) (clean)

```text
task a points=5
task b points=3
cycle c start=-1 end=5 capacity=8 members=a,b
```

### PM010 cycle over capacity / Without capacity or history nothing is enforced #3 (line 27) (clean)

```text
task a points=13
cycle c start=-1 end=5 members=a
```

### PM010 cycle over capacity / A closed cycle is not judged #4 (line 34) (clean)

```text
task a points=13
cycle c start=-10 end=-5 capacity=3 members=a closed
```
